label: Pre-filing
interventions: Meet the alderperson before the plan is fixed
Ask for a traffic and transit study scope

label: PD filing
interventions: Read the filed PD statements
Flag the dropped Red Line station

label: Community meeting
interventions: Testify at the required PD meeting
Bring translated materials for Chinatown seniors

label: Plan Commission
interventions: Written comments
Public testimony

label: Zoning committee
interventions: Committee testimony

label: Council vote
interventions: Lobby your own alderperson

label: Agreement / TIF terms
interventions: Future TIF amendments or moves of TIF funds (need a new Council vote)
Annual TIF reports and audits
Garage operating policy (event pricing, residential permits)

label: Permits & phase approvals
interventions: Site plan review for each later phase
Affordable housing compliance plans for residential phases
River permits for later edge segments
Traffic management plan updates

label: Construction
interventions: Negotiate a CBA with the developer
Introduce an ordinance (Woodlawn route)
Land trust acquisitions in Chinatown
Local hiring and contracting monitoring
source: DPD release, Jul 2026 (stadium broke ground spring 2026)
